```{r}
############ need to clean these two rows in the year 2021 there were two matches but match id is not in sequence 
# Find the row indices
idx1 <- which(match_joined$match_id == 1226886)
idx2 <- which(match_joined$match_id == 1226882)

# Swap the match_id values
temp <- match_joined$match_id[idx1]
match_joined$match_id[idx1] <- match_joined$match_id[idx2]
match_joined$match_id[idx2] <- temp
```
## Clean Match data to different Season
```{r match_clean_to_season, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# Sort by match_id
match_joined <- match_joined[order(match_joined$match_id), ]

# Identify season breaks where the gap between match_ids > 5
season_breaks <- c(TRUE, diff(match_joined$match_id) > 5)

# Assign numeric season numbers
match_joined$season <- cumsum(season_breaks)

# Convert numeric season to actual year
start_year <- 2011
match_joined$season <- start_year + match_joined$season - 1

# Split dataset by season (year)
season_list <- split(match_joined, match_joined$season)

# Save each season CSV with year-based filenames
for (yr in names(season_list)) {
  write.csv(season_list[[yr]], paste0("data/season_", yr, ".csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}

# Season summary for verification
season_summary_df <- aggregate(match_id ~ season, data = match_joined, 
                               FUN = function(x) c(start = min(x), end = max(x), count = length(x)))

season_summary_df <- data.frame(
  season = season_summary_df$season,
  start_id = season_summary_df$match_id[, "start"],
  end_id = season_summary_df$match_id[, "end"],
  match_count = season_summary_df$match_id[, "count"]
)

print(season_summary_df)

# verify that matches sum is 604 
nrow(match_joined) == sum(season_summary_df$match_count)

# add the different season to files
season_2011 <- read_csv("./data/season_2011.csv")
season_2012 <- read_csv("./data/season_2012.csv")
season_2013 <- read_csv("./data/season_2013.csv")
season_2014 <- read_csv("./data/season_2014.csv")
season_2015 <- read_csv("./data/season_2015.csv")

season_2022 <- read_csv("./data/season_2022.csv")
season_2023 <- read_csv("./data/season_2023.csv")
```

# EDA

## Match Data
```{r}
# Per season analysis 
## Number of Matches in a season played by different teams
### Note the counts include the actual matches played ignoring all games which, are draws, or were decided by a bowl-off, or were ###rained out
(season_match_counts <- season_summary_df[, c("season", "match_count")])

# Bar plot: matches per season
ggplot(season_match_counts, aes(x = factor(season), y = match_count)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_text(aes(label = match_count), vjust = -0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Matches Played per Season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Matches Played"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```


```{r}
## Number of teams that have won the match

# Count of matches won per team per season
season_team_wins <- match_joined %>%
  group_by(season, winner) %>%
  summarise(matches_won = n(), .groups = "drop")

sum(season_team_wins$matches_won)

# interactive stacked bar plot
p <- ggplot(season_team_wins, aes(x = factor(season), y = matches_won, fill = winner, text = paste("Team:", winner, "<br>Matches Won:", matches_won))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  geom_text(aes(label = matches_won), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Matches Won by Each Team per Season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Matches Won"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
```


```{r}
# Perth Scorchers have won the most BBL trophies with a record five titles 
  
# Highlight Perth Scorchers' total wins
# Calculate season winner (winner of the last match in each season)
season_winners <- season_summary_df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    final_match_id = end_id,
    season_winner = match_joined$winner[match_joined$match_id == end_id],
    season_year = match_joined$season[match_joined$match_id == end_id]
  ) %>%
  select(final_match_id, season = season_year, season_winner)

# Count of trophies won by each team
trophy_counts <- season_winners %>%
  group_by(season_winner) %>%
  summarise(trophies_won = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(trophies_won))

trophy_counts

```

```{r toss_analysis_perth_scorchers}
# toss analysis

# Total matches played by Perth Scorchers
perth_total_matches <- match_joined %>%
  filter(team1 == "Perth Scorchers" | team2 == "Perth Scorchers") %>%
  group_by(season) %>%
  summarise(total_matches = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Matches won after winning the toss, split by toss decision
perth_toss_wins <- match_joined %>%
  filter(toss_winner == "Perth Scorchers") %>%
  group_by(season, toss_decision) %>%
  summarise(matches_won = sum(winner == "Perth Scorchers"),
            tosses_won = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(win_rate = round(matches_won / tosses_won * 100, 1))

# Join total matches for reference
perth_toss_wins <- perth_toss_wins %>%
  left_join(perth_total_matches, by = "season") %>%
  mutate(percentage_of_total = round(matches_won / total_matches * 100, 1))

# Determine which decision was better per season
best_decision <- perth_toss_wins %>%
  group_by(season) %>%
  slice_max(win_rate, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  select(season, best_decision = toss_decision, best_win_rate = win_rate)

# Merge back to annotate
perth_toss_wins <- perth_toss_wins %>%
  left_join(best_decision, by = "season")

# Interactive bar chart
p <- ggplot(perth_toss_wins,
            aes(x = factor(season), y = win_rate, fill = toss_decision,
                text = paste("Season:", season,
                             "<br>Toss Decision:", toss_decision,
                             "<br>Matches Won:", matches_won,
                             "<br>Tosses Won:", tosses_won,
                             "<br>Win Rate:", win_rate, "%",
                             "<br>Total Matches:", total_matches,
                             "<br>Better Option This Season:", best_decision))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(win_rate, "%")),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Perth Scorchers: Toss Decision Success Rate (Bat vs Field) per Season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Win Rate (%)",
    fill = "Toss Decision"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")

# Overall comparison summary
overall_summary <- perth_toss_wins %>%
  group_by(toss_decision) %>%
  summarise(total_wins = sum(matches_won),
            total_tosses = sum(tosses_won),
            overall_win_rate = round(total_wins / total_tosses * 100, 1),
            .groups = "drop")

print(overall_summary)


```
## 6/8 teams won their matches if they chose to field first
```{r toss_analysis_all_teams}
library(dplyr)

# Get list of all team names
teams <- unique(c(match_joined$team1, match_joined$team2))

toss_results_list <- list()

for (team in teams) {
  
  # Total matches played by team
  total_matches <- match_joined %>%
    filter(team1 == team | team2 == team) %>%
    group_by(season) %>%
    summarise(total_matches = n(), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Matches where team won the toss
  toss_wins <- match_joined %>%
    filter(toss_winner == team) %>%
    group_by(season, toss_decision) %>%
    summarise(matches_won = sum(winner == team),
              tosses_won = n(),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(win_rate = round(matches_won / tosses_won * 100, 1))
  
  # Add total matches
  toss_wins <- toss_wins %>%
    left_join(total_matches, by = "season") %>%
    mutate(percentage_of_total = round(matches_won / total_matches * 100, 1))
  
  # Best decision per season
  best_decision <- toss_wins %>%
    group_by(season) %>%
    slice_max(win_rate, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    select(season, best_decision = toss_decision, best_win_rate = win_rate)
  
  # Add to data
  toss_wins <- toss_wins %>%
    left_join(best_decision, by = "season")
  
  # Overall summary
  overall_summary <- toss_wins %>%
    group_by(toss_decision) %>%
    summarise(total_wins = sum(matches_won),
              total_tosses = sum(tosses_won),
              overall_win_rate = round(total_wins / total_tosses * 100, 1),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(team = team) %>%
    select(team, toss_decision, total_wins, total_tosses, overall_win_rate)
  
  toss_results_list[[team]] <- overall_summary
}

# Combine all teams’ summaries
toss_results_all <- bind_rows(toss_results_list)

print(toss_results_all)

# Multi-faceted toss decision analysis plot
p_toss_analysis <- ggplot(toss_results_all, 
                          aes(x = toss_decision, 
                              y = overall_win_rate, 
                              fill = toss_decision)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(overall_win_rate, "%")), 
            vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ team, ncol = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Toss Decision Effectiveness by Team",
    subtitle = "Win Rate (%) after Winning the Toss – Bat vs Field",
    x = "Toss Decision",
    y = "Win Rate (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5)
  )

# Convert to interactive
ggplotly(p_toss_analysis)

```

```{r}
  filter(toss_winner == "Perth Scorchers") %>%
  group_by(season, toss_decision) %>%
  summarise(matches_won = sum(winner == "Perth Scorchers"), .groups = "drop")

# Combine total matches for tooltip
perth_toss_wins <- perth_toss_wins %>%
  left_join(perth_total_matches, by = "season") %>%
  mutate(percentage_of_total = round(matches_won / total_matches * 100, 1))

# Interactive stacked bar chart
p <- ggplot(perth_toss_wins,
            aes(x = factor(season), y = matches_won, fill = toss_decision,
                text = paste("Season:", season,
                             "<br>Toss Decision:", toss_decision,
                             "<br>Matches Won:", matches_won,
                             "<br>Total Matches:", total_matches,
                             "<br>% of Total Matches Won:", percentage_of_total, "%"))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(
    title = "Perth Scorchers: Wins After Winning Toss (Bat vs Field) per Season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Matches Won",
    fill = "Toss Decision"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
```
